# nico_uefi_credential (Resource)

UEFI Credential endpoints allow creating site-default host and DPU UEFI credentials for a Site

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_uefi_credential" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
  kind                           = "kind-value"
  password                       = "password-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Which site-default UEFI credential to create.
- `password` (String) Credential password.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site where the credential is stored.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource ID.
